# UpLife Painting

> UpLife Painting is a residential painting company based in Macomb Township, Michigan, serving homeowners throughout Macomb County and surrounding areas.

UpLife Painting provides interior painting, exterior painting, siding and trim painting and repair, drywall and minor surface repairs, and power washing. The company emphasizes preparation before painting, clean application, surface repairs, masking, and free estimates.

## Contact

- Website: https://www.uplifepainting.com/
- Phone: 586-356-3663
- Location: Macomb Township, Michigan
- Primary service area: Macomb County, Michigan
- Estimates: Free
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/people/Uplifepainting/61594038056853/

## Services

- Interior painting: walls, ceilings, trim, doors, cabinets, patching and sanding.
- Exterior painting: siding, gables, soffits, fascia, shutters, garage doors and entry doors.
- Siding and trim: replacement of damaged boards, trim repairs, caulking, priming and painting.
- Drywall and minor repairs: nail pops, cracks, dents, small holes, corner damage and surface preparation.
- Power washing: siding, brick, block, driveways, walkways and porches, including preparation for exterior painting.

## Service Areas

UpLife Painting is based in Macomb Township and serves Macomb County and surrounding areas, including Macomb Township, Shelby Township, Sterling Heights, Clinton Township, Washington Township, Chesterfield, New Baltimore, Harrison Township, Mount Clemens, Utica, Romeo, Armada, Ray Township, Bruce Township, Richmond, Fraser, Roseville, St. Clair Shores, Warren, Eastpointe and Center Line.

## Business Information

UpLife Painting is the painting service of UpLife Home Improvement. The company works primarily on residential properties and offers free, no-obligation estimates.
